sources.support: signed range and int minimum width16; actual width implementation-defined
truncation; unrepresentable truncated destination value undefined

derivation: C++ guarantees signed int positive max >=32767. For nonnegative finite quotient, offline truncate and require steps<=32766, so both conversion and steps+1<=32767 are language-guaranteed representable. Actual native int width is not inferred. speedReduction * steps * (steps + 1) is already double multiplication, so no integer-square restriction.
limit_kind: offline source-arithmetic portable representability, not physical speed/brake safety threshold
